items.followUp: What is an IP address used for in a computer network?

rubric.why: The answer defines an IP address as a unique numerical address.
rubric.description: Defines an IP address as a unique numerical address assigned to a device on a network.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying it as a unique numerical address.

rubric.why: The answer states what the address does for the device.
rubric.description: Explains that an IP address identifies a device and allows it to communicate on a network.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for explaining that it identifies a device or enables communication on a network.

modelAnswer: An IP address is a unique numerical address assigned to a device on a network.
It identifies the device and allows it to communicate with other devices.
